full_prompt_en: A square, softly finished oil landscape centers on a quiet lake winding between wooded banks and high cliffs at sunset. In the near left foreground, broken rocks and low plants cluster beneath a broad tree whose dark crown reaches toward the middle of the sky. Smaller trees stand behind it along the shore. Across the water, a line of darker trees gathers at the foot of a steep ochre cliff on the right. The cliff rises nearly to the top of the picture, with irregular vertical faces and warm shadowed ledges. The lake draws inward through the center toward hazy violet hills. A small pale sun hangs above that distance in an amber sky. Its light lays a short, glowing orange path across the still water near the foreground. The atmosphere gradually softens far edges, while nearby rock, foliage and bank receive more distinct painted detail. Greens and deep browns weigh down the lower corners, then dissolve into warm gold, rose and lavender toward the horizon. No figures interrupt the scene. The reflection is calm and broad, without sharply separated ripples. Light comes from the low sun and seems to fill the whole valley, making distant planes luminous while the left tree and shore remain in quiet shadow. Fine blended strokes render the sky and distance, contrasting with denser touches among stones and leaves. The composition frames an open central route with two darker sides, allowing the eye to move from a textured foreground to a far, glowing gap. The whole view is tranquil and warmly atmospheric, its detail subordinated to the steady sunset light.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、处理柔和的油画风景以日落时蜿蜒于林岸与高崖之间的静湖为中心。近处左前方，碎石和低矮植物聚在一棵大树下，深色树冠伸向天空中央。更小的树沿岸站在它后方。水对面，右侧陡峭赭色山崖脚下聚着一线较暗树木。山崖几乎升至画面顶部，表面有不规则竖向崖面和暖色阴影岩层。湖水从中央向内延伸，通往朦胧的紫色远山。一轮浅色小太阳悬在远处上方的琥珀天空中。它的光在前景附近静水上铺出一小段发亮的橙色道路。空气渐渐柔化远方边缘，近处岩石、树叶和岸坡则保有更明确的绘画细节。绿色与深褐色压住下方两角，向地平线逐步溶入暖金、玫瑰和淡紫色。没有人物打断景象。倒影平静而宽展，没有锐利分开的波纹。光来自低垂太阳，似乎充满整条谷地，让远方平面发亮，同时左侧大树和岸边留在安静阴影里。细腻晕合的笔触描绘天空与远方，与石块和叶间较密的落笔相对。构图用两侧深色框住中央开阔的路线，让视线从有肌理的前景走向远处发光的缺口。整幅景象宁静、充满暖空气感，细节都服从稳定的夕光。
style_prompt_en: The image has a smooth oil-painted atmosphere with delicate blending across broad luminous areas and denser, more particular touches near the lower edge. Amber, gold and warm rose light spread through a muted sky, then pass into mauve distance and deep green-brown shadow. A low bright point generates a soft reflected band, but the scene avoids hard glare. Dark framing masses on both sides guide the eye toward an open, glowing center. Layered tonal planes recede gradually: textured near passages yield to softened middle forms and a misty horizon. Edges vary from clear silhouettes in shadow to barely visible transitions in the light-filled distance. The color is restrained and integrated, with warm illumination unifying separate surfaces. The perspective is broad and calm, its long inward route balanced by stable lateral weight. Brush texture remains present without breaking the overall softness. The result is contemplative and spatially deep, with haze, measured contrast and a patient glow carrying the visual character.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有平顺的油画空气感，宽阔发光区域细腻晕合，下缘附近的笔触则更密、更具体。琥珀、金色与暖玫瑰光铺过低饱和天空，再转入淡紫远方与深绿褐阴影。低处亮点形成柔和反光带，却没有刺眼强光。两侧深色框架团块引导视线进入开阔、发光的中央。层叠的明暗平面逐渐退远：有肌理的近处让位于柔化中景和雾状地平线。边缘从阴影中清楚的剪影变化到充满光线的远处几乎不可辨的过渡。色彩克制而统一，暖照明把分离表面连在一起。透视宽阔平静，向内延伸的长路线由稳定的两侧重量平衡。笔触肌理仍存在，却没有打破整体柔软感。结果沉静而空间深远，由薄雾、有度的对比和缓缓发亮的光承载画面特征。
theme_en: A still lake between wooded shores and high cliffs glows under a low amber sun
theme_zh: 静湖夹在树木繁茂的岸边与高崖之间，在低垂琥珀色太阳下发光
name: Sanford Robinson Gifford
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
